claims.claim_statement: Dynamic Headroom-Aware Inflow Governor adaptively throttles primitive admission based on available VRAM headroom.
claims.supporting_evidence: Code in zerogs/admission_controller.py and train.py dynamically interpolates cap [5k, 15k]. In flowers, 8.91M candidate requests were throttled to 985K (88.93% rejection rate), maintaining peak VRAM at 7,288 MiB.
claims.confounding_factors: Telemetry logs pre-prune decision rather than post-prune allocation on PRUNE_FIRST cycles.
claims.recommended_paper_action: Retain as Core Contribution 1. Clarify that Dynamic Inflow governs candidate admission at creation.

claims.claim_statement: Marginal Knapsack Spatial Resource Allocation maximizes reconstruction gain per byte subject to a 40% split quota.
claims.supporting_evidence: Code in zerogs/marginal_allocator.py executes greedy Knapsack prioritized by lambda = demand / cost, with kappa_split=0.40 constraint verified in test suite.
claims.confounding_factors: None. Direct greedy Knapsack implementation is mathematically verified.

claims.claim_statement: Preservation-Centric Lifecycle eliminates the Over-Pruning Dilemma where Stage 1 opacity pruning destroys developing foliage.
claims.supporting_evidence: ABL-HP outperforms baseline V4 across all tested scenes: bonsai (+11.08 dB paired gain, p=0.0145), garden (+6.26 dB gain), flowers (+2.94 dB gain). Code audit proves V4 unconditionally pruned opacity < 0.005 every 100 steps.
claims.confounding_factors: ABL-HP re-enables legacy coupling where opacity is only pruned at 3k opacity resets if headroom is available.
claims.recommended_paper_action: Retain as central empirical discovery and Core Contribution 3. Formulate as Preservation-Centric Dynamic Inflow.

claims.claim_statement: Exact mathematical candidate conservation holds across all training cycles (Delta = Requested - (Admitted + Rejections) = 0).
claims.supporting_evidence: In AdmissionController, total_candidates = admissible_cap + rejected_by_cap is an identity. In telemetry, delta=0 holds for all 144 cycles in garden and flowers when evaluating dynamic cap.
claims.confounding_factors: On PRUNE_FIRST cycles, post-prune reallocation is executed with freed headroom while telemetry logged the pre-prune decision. Knapsack budget-exhaustion discard does not produce a separate telemetry rejection event.
claims.recommended_paper_action: Downgrade claim from universal pipeline theorem to strict admission-stage partition invariant. Document pre-prune reallocation clearly.

claims.claim_statement: PV-SRA-3DGS provides a Hard Physical VRAM Guarantee preventing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) on 8GB GPUs.
claims.supporting_evidence: Zero OOM events observed across 23 physical benchmark runs (30k iterations each) on RTX 5060 8GB, with peak VRAM strictly between 6,906 and 7,656 MiB.
claims.confounding_factors: Rasterizer backward pass memory depends on screen resolution, camera distance, and tile sorting, which are outside the allocator scope. External OS/WDDM memory (~1.8GB) is non-deterministic.
claims.recommended_paper_action: Downgrade claim from Hard Physical VRAM Guarantee to Headroom-Aware Bounded Densification with Zero Empirical OOMs across 23 Physical Benchmarks.

claims.claim_statement: The proposed method outperforms unconstrained 3DGS (V_ref) across novel view synthesis benchmarks while using fewer Gaussians.
claims.supporting_evidence: Verified on bonsai: ABL-HP achieves 31.83 dB mean PSNR (+2.24 dB over V_ref 29.59 dB) with 40.2% fewer Gaussians (738k vs 1.24M).
claims.confounding_factors: V_ref was physically executed only on bonsai. No physical V_ref baseline was executed on garden or flowers.
claims.recommended_paper_action: Restrict claim to bonsai where physical evidence exists. For garden/flowers, compare only against memory-bounded baseline V4, or run V_ref on garden/flowers.

claims.claim_statement: Cross-scene generalizability is proven across diverse indoor, outdoor unbounded, and complex flora topologies.
claims.supporting_evidence: Tested and verified on bonsai (31.83 dB), garden (24.93 dB), and flowers (20.30 dB). All three show consistent, statistically substantial gains over baseline V4 (+11.08 dB, +6.26 dB, +2.94 dB).
claims.confounding_factors: Cross-scene runs on garden and flowers were conducted on Seed 0 only (multi-seed battery n=3 was conducted on bonsai).
claims.recommended_paper_action: Retain cross-scene generalizability claim. Acknowledge single-seed execution for garden/flowers as a scope limitation.

claims.claim_statement: Paired multi-seed improvement achieves statistical significance (p = 0.01451, Cohen d = 4.74).
claims.supporting_evidence: Independent recomputation confirms paired t(2) = 8.2110, p = 0.01451, Cohen d = 4.7406, 95% CI [+5.28, +16.89] dB across Seeds 0, 1, 2 on bonsai.
claims.confounding_factors: Small sample size n=3 has low degrees of freedom (df=2). Sensitive to normality assumptions.
claims.recommended_paper_action: Retain inferential statistics. Explicitly disclose df=2 limitation in paper Section 9 (Limitations).
